```{r}
# 1. Same-morphotaxon nearest neighbor tables
same_files <- tibble(
  file = c(
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/BA_NearSameTaxa.csv",
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/FR4_NearSameTaxa.csv",
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/LA_NearSameTaxa.csv"
  ),
  site = c("BA", "FR4", "LA")
)

same_taxa <- same_files %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  select(-file) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IN_FID), !is.na(NEAR_FID), !is.na(NEAR_DIST), IN_FID != NEAR_FID) %>%
  group_by(site, IN_FID) %>%
  summarise(
    closest_same_dist = min(NEAR_DIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Different-morphotaxon / multi-rank tables (standardizing FR4's PRED_DESC_ / PRED_DESC1)
read_diff_reef <- function(path, reef_name) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(site = reef_name)

  if (reef_name == "FR4") {
    df %>%
      mutate(
        taxa_in = as.character(PRED_DESC_),
        taxa_near = as.character(PRED_DESC1)
      )
  } else {
    df %>%
      mutate(
        taxa_in = as.character(CLEANEDPRE),
        taxa_near = as.character(CLEANEDPRE_1)
      )
  }
}

diff_raw <- pmap_dfr(
  list(
    c(
      "data/Nearest Neighbor/BA_neardifftaxa.csv",
      "data/Nearest Neighbor/FR4_neardifftaxa.csv",
      "data/Nearest Neighbor/LA_neardifftaxa.csv"
    ),
    c("BA", "FR4", "LA")
  ),
  read_diff_reef
)

focal_info <- diff_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(IN_FID), !is.na(taxa_in)) %>%
  group_by(site, IN_FID) %>%
  summarise(
    morphotaxon = first(taxa_in),
    colony_area = first(IN_AREA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diff_taxa <- diff_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(IN_FID), !is.na(NEAR_FID), !is.na(NEAR_DIST),
    IN_FID != NEAR_FID,
    !is.na(taxa_in), !is.na(taxa_near),
    taxa_near != taxa_in
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, IN_FID) %>%
  summarise(
    closest_diff_dist = min(NEAR_DIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    closest_diff_taxa = taxa_near[which.min(NEAR_DIST)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

colony_proximity <- focal_info %>%
  full_join(same_taxa, by = c("site", "IN_FID")) %>%
  full_join(diff_taxa, by = c("site", "IN_FID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(closest_same_dist, closest_diff_dist),
    names_to = "neighbor_type",
    values_to = "nearest_dist"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    neighbor_type = recode(
      neighbor_type,
      closest_same_dist = "Same Morphotaxon",
      closest_diff_dist = "Different Morphotaxon"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(nearest_dist))

# 3. Ripley's K tables (BA, FA4, LA)
ripleys_k <- tibble(
  file = c(
    "data/Ripleys K/BA_Ripley's.csv",
    "data/Ripleys K/FA4_Ripley's.csv",
    "data/Ripleys K/LA_Ripley's.csv"
  ),
  site = c("BA", "FA4", "LA")
) %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  select(-file) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(step = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Colony attribute tables (standardizing FR's pred_desc_)
attrs_all <- pmap_dfr(
  list(
    c(
      "data/Colony Attributes/BA_attributes.csv",
      "data/Colony Attributes/FR_attributes.csv",
      "data/Colony Attributes/LA_attributes.csv"
    ),
    c("BA", "FR", "LA")
  ),
  function(path, reef_name) {
    df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(site = reef_name)
    taxa_col <- if ("CleanedPre" %in% names(df)) "CleanedPre" else "pred_desc_"
    df %>%
      mutate(morphotaxon = as.character(.data[[taxa_col]])) %>%
      filter(!is.na(morphotaxon))
  }
)
```

```{r}
ripleys_k %>% filter(site == "FA4")
```

```{r}
#| label: fix-site-and-check-zeros
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Standardize FA4 -> FR4 in Ripley's K (and FR -> FR4 in attributes if matching)
ripleys_k <- ripleys_k %>%
  mutate(site = recode(site, FA4 = "FR4"))

attrs_all <- attrs_all %>%
  mutate(site = recode(site, FR = "FR4"))

# 2. Check NEAR_DIST == 0 across raw same-taxa and different-taxa pairs
same_raw <- tibble(
  file = c(
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/BA_NearSameTaxa.csv",
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/FR4_NearSameTaxa.csv",
    "data/Nearest Neighbor/LA_NearSameTaxa.csv"
  ),
  site = c("BA", "FR4", "LA")
) %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  select(-file) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IN_FID), !is.na(NEAR_FID), !is.na(NEAR_DIST), IN_FID != NEAR_FID) %>%
  mutate(source = "same_taxa")

diff_pairs_clean <- diff_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(IN_FID), !is.na(NEAR_FID), !is.na(NEAR_DIST),
    IN_FID != NEAR_FID,
    !is.na(taxa_in), !is.na(taxa_near),
    taxa_near != taxa_in
  ) %>%
  mutate(source = "diff_taxa")

near_zero_summary <- bind_rows(
  same_raw %>% select(site, source, NEAR_DIST),
  diff_pairs_clean %>% select(site, source, NEAR_DIST)
) %>%
  group_by(site, source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    n_zero = sum(NEAR_DIST == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_zero = round(100 * mean(NEAR_DIST == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

near_zero_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: stats-and-figures
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Summary stats by site and neighbor_type
prox_summary <- colony_proximity %>%
  group_by(site, neighbor_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_dist = median(nearest_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_dist = IQR(nearest_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(nearest_dist, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(nearest_dist, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Overall Wilcoxon rank-sum test: Same vs. Different morphotaxon
wilcox_overall <- wilcox.test(nearest_dist ~ neighbor_type, data = colony_proximity)

# Within-site Wilcoxon tests
wilcox_by_site <- colony_proximity %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(nearest_dist ~ neighbor_type)$p.value,
    w_stat = unname(wilcox.test(nearest_dist ~ neighbor_type)$statistic),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Size vs. distance correlation (Spearman) where colony_area is available
size_cor_by_site <- colony_proximity %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_area), !is.na(nearest_dist)) %>%
  group_by(site, neighbor_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    rho = cor(colony_area, nearest_dist, method = "spearman"),
    p_value = cor.test(colony_area, nearest_dist, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Proximity figure (two-line labels to prevent overlap)
p_prox <- colony_proximity %>%
  mutate(
    neighbor_label = recode(
      neighbor_type,
      "Same Morphotaxon" = "Same\nMorphotaxon",
      "Different Morphotaxon" = "Different\nMorphotaxon"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbor_label, y = nearest_dist, fill = neighbor_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, width = 0.55, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Nearest-Neighbor Distance",
    title = "Closest Same- vs. Different-Morphotaxon Coral Neighbors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(lineheight = 1.1, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

ggsave("outputs/fig_same_vs_diff_taxa.png", p_prox, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Ripley's K figure across sites
p_ripley <- ggplot(ripleys_k, aes(x = step)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LwConfEnv, ymax = HiConfEnv), alpha = 0.25, fill = "grey50") +
  geom_line(aes(y = ExpectedK, linetype = "Expected K"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ObservedK, color = site), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Distance Step",
    y = "K Value",
    color = "Site",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Observed vs. Expected Ripley's K and Confidence Envelope"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))

ggsave("outputs/fig_ripleys_k.png", p_ripley, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

list(
  prox_summary = prox_summary,
  wilcox_overall = wilcox_overall,
  wilcox_by_site = wilcox_by_site,
  size_cor_by_site = size_cor_by_site
)
```
Results:
Overall & Within-Site Proximity (wilcox_overall & wilcox_by_site): Nearest-neighbor distances differ significantly between Same Morphotaxon and Different Morphotaxon overall ($W = 8,107,456$, $p < 2.2 \times 10^{-16}$) and within every reef (BA: $p = 1.21 \times 10^{-153}$; FR4: $p = 6.54 \times 10^{-32}$; LA: $p = 2.42 \times 10^{-7}$).Medians (prox_summary): At BA, the median distance to the closest Different Morphotaxon neighbor is 0.00 (touching/overlapping), whereas for Same Morphotaxon it is 0.0277 (with a small iqr_dist print quirk in the pasted columns—check prox_summary$iqr_dist directly if needed). At FR4 and LA, medians are 0.00 for both groups, meaning the distributions differ in shape/spread and zero vs. non-zero proportions rather than median alone.Colony Size vs. Nearest-Neighbor Distance (size_cor_by_site):Same Morphotaxon: Positive Spearman correlations ($\rho \approx 0.24$ to $0.32$, all $p < 10^{-25}$) across all three reefs (BA: $\rho = 0.257$; FR4: $\rho = 0.241$; LA: $\rho = 0.320$)—larger colonies tend to be farther from their closest same-morphotaxon neighbor.Different Morphotaxon: Weak negative correlations at BA ($\rho = -0.173$, $p = 1.89 \times 10^{-14}$) and FR4 ($\rho = -0.109$, $p = 8.75 \times 10^{-6}$), and no significant correlation at LA ($\rho = -0.032$, $p = 0.342$).

```{r}
    col.names = c("Site", "Neighbor Type", "n", "Median", "IQR", "Q25", "Q75"),
    caption = "Closest nearest-neighbor distance summary by reef site and morphotaxon relationship."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ripleys-k
#| fig-cap: "Multi-distance spatial clustering (Ripley's K) across distance steps for each reef site. The shaded grey band shows the simulation confidence envelope (LwConfEnv to HiConfEnv) expected under complete spatial randomness; when ObservedK rises above the upper confidence envelope, colonies are more spatially clustered than random at that scale, whereas values inside or below the envelope indicate random or dispersed spacing."
p_ripley <- ggplot(ripleys_k, aes(x = step)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LwConfEnv, ymax = HiConfEnv), alpha = 0.25, fill = "grey50") +
  geom_line(aes(y = ExpectedK, linetype = "Expected K"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ObservedK, color = site), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Distance Step",
    y = "K Value",
    color = "Site",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = "Observed vs. Expected Ripley's K and Confidence Envelope"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

ggsave("outputs/fig_ripleys_k.png", p_ripley, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

# Format and round your prox_summary table cleanly
tbl_clean <- prox_summary %>%
  mutate(across(c(median_dist, iqr_dist, q25, q75), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  rename(
    Site = site,
    `Neighbor Type` = neighbor_type,
    n = n,
    `Median (m)` = median_dist,
    `IQR (m)` = iqr_dist,
    `Q25 (m)` = q25,
    `Q75 (m)` = q75
  )

# Save as a 300-DPI PNG in your outputs folder
png("outputs/tbl_proximity_summary.png", width = 8, height = 2.6, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.table(tbl_clean, rows = NULL)
dev.off()
```
